title: Turnaround video · a cast sheet or a character filmed all the way round
description: Build plan N7-6 (new-models-7.md §3.7 recipes B and C): POST /api/turnaround, priced by /api/turnaround/estimate, on your pictures of one consenting person or a made-up character in local/turnaround/: front.png, right.png, back.png and left.png (their own right and left: facing them, their right side is on your left; full body, a plain background) and sheet.png (a turnaround sheet of the same character). The open engine films the views as Frames mode's Wan 2.2 14B start/end-frame chain, the sides it has no picture of drawn first by the Angles app's open route; the cloud takes them as MiniMax H3 Max references (Image 1…n), FLUX 3 Max keyframes, or, from the front alone, an H3 Max camera-controls orbit. Identity is ArcFace-style face similarity (AuraFace, or --identity-model buffalo_l) of 8 frames sampled from the film against the person's views; about half the frames show the back, so the face rate is expected near 0.5. A GPU or key run picks the default route per engine from this suite: identity first, then temporal steadiness and prompt match. The words are Fuobe's own.

default.description: Each engine's default route: Frames (Wan 2.2 14B) on your GPU, H3 Max reference-to-video in the cloud

keyframes.description: FLUX 3 Max keyframes-to-video: each view at its quarter of the turn (cloud)

camera.description: H3 Max camera controls: an exact clockwise orbit from the front view alone, the sides and back invented (cloud)
